'''Sanriv''' [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The eight [[Casino/Legends|casino]] rooms aboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' were decorated with scarlet [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]] inset with sanriv gemstones.<ref name="EGVV" />
